note:
v9, THE FACING PAGE (whole song: its form now reads the same from both ends). Close a book on wet ink and the other page takes the mirror image. After the signed F chord the song's first six strips return, read from the far end by the other hand. 3:52.9 the right guitar alone plays the riff backwards for two strips, with bass, foot, hat and snare; the opening had the left guitar alone, forwards. The crash that began the ink at 0:11 now ends it at 3:58.3. Then the clean guitar leads forwards where it once answered backwards, and first the ribbon, then the wordless mouth sing the hook the other way: C–Gb–Ab–F, three times. The sticks stop but the foot keeps closing the hi-hat in quarters. Why six strips: of every strip ending near here, only this one falls on a downbeat. The song opens with a short F3 on beat one of bar 1; it now closes with the same F3, held, on beat one of bar 109, with the foot. The forward hook stops on C; read backwards it comes home. Nothing before 3:52.9 has a changed note; the countersignature (v7) is intact and no longer the last thing heard.
